title: Top 10 Scenic Places to Visit in Lansdowne, Uttarakhand
author: Flutter Editorial Team
excerpt: Discover Tip-in-Top viewpoint, Bhulla Lake, St. John Church, and quiet pine forests surrounding Flutter Hotels & Resorts, Lansdowne.
metaTitle: Top 10 Places to Visit in Lansdowne | Flutter Hotels Blog
metaDescription: Explore top attractions near Flutter Hotels & Resorts, Lansdowne — Tip-in-Top, Bhulla Lake, War Memorial & scenic hill views.
content:
1. Tip-In-Top (Tiffin Top)

Located at the highest point in Lansdowne, Tip-In-Top offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Garhwal Himalayan range. Just a short 10-minute drive from Flutter Hotels & Resorts, it is the best spot for sunrise photography and peaceful pine walks.

2. Bhulla Lake

A serene man-made lake maintained by the Garhwal Rifles. Visitors can enjoy paddle boating, feed ducks, and relax by the lakeside garden.

3. St. John's Church

Built in 1936, St. John's Church is a historic Roman Catholic church known for its colonial architecture and peaceful surroundings amidst tall pine trees.

4. Garhwal Rifles Regimental Museum

A treasure trove of military history showcasing rare weapons, uniforms, and historical artifacts dating back to 1887.
